# nico_audit (Data Source)

Audit is a record of actions taken by users on the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_audit" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "audit_name" {
  value = data.nico_audit.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `failed_only` (String) Return only audit log entries that have failed status code (>= 400)
- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.

### Read-Only

- `api_version` (String) API version
- `body` (String) HTTP body in JSON format
- `client_ip` (String) Client IP address
- `duration_ms` (Number) API execution duration in milliseconds
- `endpoint` (String) API endpoint
- `extra_data` (String) Extra data in JSON format
- `method` (String) HTTP method
- `org_name` (String) Organization name
- `query_params` (String) Query parameters
- `status_code` (Number) HTTP response status code
- `status_message` (String) HTTP response status message
- `timestamp` (String) API execution time
- `user` (Attributes) User that executed the API call (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user))
- `user_id` (String) User ID that executed the API call

<a id="nestedatt--user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) The date that the user was created.
- `email` (String) Email used by the user to register with NGC
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the given user.
- `last_name` (String) Surname of the user
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the user was last updated in NICo
